faq.q: ide the Boomerang Yacht Trips Can I buy a ticket at check-in?
faq.a: The Boomerang Yacht usually sells out in advance, so unfortunately the answer is most likely no. However, we never want anyone to miss out on a trip on the Boomerang, so if there is a “no-show”, we would be willing to sell a ticket on the spot. If a cruise is sold out, is there a waiting list? No, Boomerang does not keep a waiting list for our cruises. Cruises do sell out, and often well in advance, so please make sure to purchase your tickets far in advance, especially if you have limited time
